feature: Consolidate OpenTelemetry packages and enable tree-shaking
workflow_rationale: This is a refactor workflow because we're reorganizing the OpenTelemetry package structure to reduce bundle size while preserving all existing functionality. We follow the refactor pattern: Audit → Add New → Migrate → Remove Old → Cleanup.

phases.name: Audit and Analysis
phases.description: Analyze actual OpenTelemetry usage across the codebase to identify which instrumentations are truly needed

subtasks.description: Analyze which OpenTelemetry instrumentations are actively used

verification.instructions: Review AUDIT_REPORT.md to confirm it lists: (1) actively used instrumentations, (2) unused packages, (3) version conflicts, (4) recommended package list

subtasks.expected_output: Document identifying: actively used instrumentations (http, express, fs), unused instrumentations, version alignment needs, and recommended minimal package set
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive AUDIT_REPORT.md analyzing 13 installed packages, identifying 6 missing packages, documenting version conflicts, listing 4 redundant packages, and providing recommended consolidated package list with migration strategy. Key findings: version conflicts (0.26.x-2.5.x), redundant instrumentations in auto-instrumentations-node, missing packages like @opentelemetry/instrumentation-pg and @opentelemetry/sdk-metrics. Expected benefits: ~500KB bundle reduction, improved tree-shaking.

subtasks.description: Calculate current bundle size impact of OpenTelemetry packages
subtasks.expected_output: Document showing current vs potential bundle size with consolidated packages
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive BUNDLE_ANALYSIS.md with detailed breakdown: Current bundle ~2.5-3.5 MB (server), 13 packages + 30+ transitive deps from auto-instrumentations. Proposed: ~1.0-1.5 MB, 10 packages, 40-60% reduction. Analyzed webpack stub config (browser: 0 KB, fully stubbed), tree-shaking limitations (auto-instrumentations prevents optimization), version conflicts (5 ranges: 0.26-2.5), and redundant packages (~520 KB). Estimated savings: 1.96 MB (64%) by removing auto-instrumentations-node and selective instrumentations. Includes recommendations, risk assessment, and success metrics.

subtasks.description: Evaluate @vercel/otel vs manual package approach

verification.instructions: Review APPROACH_DECISION.md to confirm it documents the chosen approach (@vercel/otel or manual packages) with rationale

subtasks.expected_output: Decision document: choose @vercel/otel (simpler, smaller) OR manual packages (more control). Include pros/cons and rationale.

phases.name: Package Consolidation
phases.description: Install consolidated/aligned OpenTelemetry packages alongside existing ones

subtasks.description: Align OpenTelemetry package versions to latest compatible set

verification.expected: All @opentelemetry packages show consistent version numbers

subtasks.notes: Update all @opentelemetry/* packages to use compatible versions from the same release. Based on audit, likely target: 1.x for API, 0.52.x for SDK packages.

subtasks.description: Replace auto-instrumentations-node with selective instrumentations
subtasks.notes: Remove auto-instrumentations-node (30+ deps). Keep only: @opentelemetry/instrumentation-http, @opentelemetry/instrumentation-express. Remove unused: instrumentation-fs, instrumentation-dns, etc.

subtasks.description: Add tree-shaking configuration to next.config.mjs
subtasks.notes: Add @opentelemetry packages to experimental.optimizePackageImports to enable tree-shaking

phases.name: Consolidate Implementation Files
phases.description: Merge duplicate OpenTelemetry configuration files into single canonical implementation

subtasks.description: Create unified opentelemetry-setup.ts merging best of both implementations
subtasks.notes: Combine opentelemetry.ts and opentelemetry-config.ts into single file. Use selective imports (no auto-instrumentations), preserve OTLP/Prometheus exporters, tail-based sampling.

subtasks.description: Update src/instrument.ts to use new unified implementation
subtasks.notes: Update import to use new opentelemetry-setup.ts instead of old files

subtasks.description: Update all 23 files importing OpenTelemetry to use new structure
subtasks.notes: Update imports across all 23 files to reference new unified implementation. Ensure no files still import old opentelemetry.ts or opentelemetry-config.ts

phases.name: Update Webpack Stub Configuration
phases.description: Update next.config.mjs stubs to reflect new package structure

subtasks.description: Remove stubs for unused instrumentation packages
subtasks.notes: Remove webpack alias for @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node since it will no longer be installed

subtasks.description: Add stubs for remaining selective instrumentations
subtasks.notes: Create browser stubs for the selective instrumentations we're keeping (http, express) to prevent bundling in client builds

phases.name: Remove Old Packages and Files
phases.description: Remove deprecated packages, duplicate implementations, and unused code

subtasks.description: Remove old OpenTelemetry implementation files
subtasks.notes: Delete src/lib/monitoring/opentelemetry.ts and src/lib/monitoring/opentelemetry-config.ts since functionality is now in opentelemetry-setup.ts. Also remove opentelemetry.stub.ts if unused.

subtasks.description: Remove unused OpenTelemetry packages from package.json

verification.command: npm ls 2>&1 | grep -c '@opentelemetry' | awk '{if($1 <= 8) print "OK"; else print "FAIL"}'

subtasks.notes: Remove packages identified as unused in audit: likely exporter-jaeger (dev only), instrumentation-fs, instrumentation-dns, possibly others. Target: reduce from 13 to ~8 packages.

subtasks.description: Run npm install to clean up dependency tree
subtasks.notes: Run npm install to ensure package-lock.json is updated and dependency tree is clean

subtasks.notes: Update documentation to match reality - either document @vercel/otel if chosen, or document selective manual package approach. Remove outdated info.

OpenTelemetry package count reduced from 13 to ~8
Bundle size for OTel packages reduced by 40-60%
Documentation updated to reflect actual implementation
verification_strategy.reasoning: Medium risk refactor - changes package structure but preserves all functionality. Requires integration testing but not full E2E or security scans.
